name: Martin Holst Swende
biography: is a Senior Security Consultant at 2Secure AB, working with application security- and penetration testing. Martin has a background as a Java/J2me-programmer but nowadays finds more joy in Python and Javascript. Martin is project leader for the Owasp Hatkit Proxy/Datafiddler projects and contributor to open source security projects such as Webscarab and Nmap. Twitter: @mhswende
